summary: Frontend-only testing of the new /shop page. Ran a single end-to-end Playwright suite covering routing, category circles + URL sync, search, sort, favorites (with localStorage persistence), Load more pagination, Quick View modal, thumbnails, Elodie variants, Adelaide odambady pair pricing, fullscreen lightbox (open + Escape close), deep-link ?category=Floral, breadcrumb, image integrity, mobile 390x844 responsive grid, and landing (/) regression. ALL checks passed.

test_results.category_circles_all_present: PASS (all, embossed, floral, minimal, foil, botanical, classic, odambady)
test_results.load_more: PASS - reveals remaining 6 (total 14), button disappears when exhausted
test_results.all_cards_clears_filter: PASS - URL cleared, count returns to 14
test_results.sort_price_asc: PASS - Lin, Noa, Amara, Rosea, Camille (65,70,85,88,90)
test_results.sort_price_desc: PASS - Solene, Elodie, Marguerite, Verona, Aurelia (135,120,110,105,100)
test_results.favorites_toggle_and_localstorage: PASS - localStorage ewc-favorites=["The Amara"], counter updates to (1)
test_results.quick_view_modal: PASS - opens on product-card click, hash sets to #card=The%20Amara
test_results.modal_thumbnails: PASS - thumb-1 present and clickable for The Amara
test_results.elodie_variants: PASS - variant-0/1/2 all present; variant-2 updates price to ₹130 / card
test_results.adelaide_odambady_pair: PASS - card shows '₹190 / pair'; modal shows ₹190 / pair (95*2)
test_results.landing_regression: PASS - 10 images all loaded, title correct, no errors

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: framer-motion warning about non-static container position for scroll offset — cosmetic, no functional impact.
Nit: Shop.jsx is ~645 lines; consider extracting ShopCard, QuickViewModal, and GalleryLightbox into separate files for maintainability (>500 lines threshold approaching).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Shop page fully verified against all 14 review-request bullets on 2026-01. Landing regression clean. Only /gifts remains a placeholder (intentionally not tested). WhatsApp link only href-verified (external navigation intentionally not followed).
